newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daishowa shares rise due to report on group profit.
newsitem.headline: Daishowa shares rise due to report on group profit.

text.p: Shares of Daishowa Paper Manufacturing Co Ltd rose on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Wednesday morning following a newspaper report that the company is expected to post its largest ever group net profit in the year to March 31.
Daishowa shares were up 28 yen to 580 by 0108 GMT.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Wednesday that the company is expected to post a record group net profit of 14 billion yen in the year to next March 31.
The company declined to comment on the report. It has had group losses for the last several years, and posted a group net loss of 2.69 billion yen in 1995/96.
